modalities.evidence: radiologist evaluations of errors in automatically generated radiology reports

output.population: 6 board certified radiologists annotating 200 pairs of candidate and ground-truth reports from 50 studies
output.summary: Annotations from six board-certified radiologists marking clinically significant and insignificant errors in six categories across 200 pairs of candidate and ground-truth radiology reports drawn from 50 MIMIC-CXR studies.
